title: Identify a number-field valuation ring with an integer-ring localization
statement: Let Ω = AlgebraicClosure ℚ, let E be a finite-dimensional intermediate field of Ω/ℚ, let ℓ be a natural prime, and let V be a valuation subring of E in which ℓ is a nonunit. Write O_E for the ring of integers of E. There exists a nonzero prime ideal q of O_E containing ℓ, with finite quotient O_E/q, such that an element x of E belongs to V exactly when x = a/b for integers a,b ∈ O_E with b ∉ q. Moreover, for every a ∈ O_E, its image in E belongs to V.nonunits exactly when a ∈ q.
lean_statement: ∀ (E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] (ℓ : ℕ), ℓ.Prime → ∀ (V : ValuationSubring E), V.LiesOverPrime ℓ → ∃ q : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers E), q.IsPrime ∧ q ≠ ⊥ ∧ (ℓ : NumberField.RingOfIntegers E) ∈ q ∧ Finite (NumberField.RingOfIntegers E ⧸ q) ∧ (∀ x : E, x ∈ V ↔ ∃ a b : NumberField.RingOfIntegers E, b ∉ q ∧ x = (a : E) / (b : E)) ∧ (∀ a : NumberField.RingOfIntegers E, (a : E) ∈ V.nonunits ↔ a ∈ q)
